description: Search Hong Kong Ordinances, subsidiary legislation and instruments by TITLE keyword, English or Traditional Chinese — "Personal Data", "個人資料", "Companies Ordinance", "公司條例". This is a title search, not full-text; it will not find a chapter by a phrase appearing only inside a section. Also accepts a bare chapter number ("486") for an exact match. Returns each match's Cap. number (for hk_law_info/hk_law_section), English and Traditional Chinese titles, in-force status, and whether it is a principal Ordinance, subsidiary legislation, or an instrument. Source: Hong Kong Department of Justice, e-Legislation.

query.description: Title keyword (English or Traditional Chinese) or a bare chapter number, e.g. "Personal Data", "個人資料", or "486".

name: hk_law_search
title: Hk Law Search
